name: Iris reveal (match-cut disc that opens the next world)
description: A disc in the next section's ground colour opens from a point that matters (a chip, the centre of a wheel, a button) and covers the frame in about 8 frames, accelerating (ease-in) so the cut lands on the full cover. Optionally the centre rides from the start point to a second point while it opens (r08's disc rides the flying chip). Build the next section's layers AFTER this recipe (creation order is stacking order) and start them on its coverFrame: the disc becomes their ground. This replaces a hard cut with a match cut: nothing in r08 ever hard-cuts.
source: r08 S1.E8 navy iris from the hero chip f140-149: radius 35 -> 1150 px, easeIn [0.391, 0.048, 1.0, 0.917], centre rides the chip (552, 1545) -> (480, 1120)
r08 S2.E14 dark iris from the wheel centre f522-529 (radius 140 -> 1500 px) and S3.E13 cream iris f762-770 (64 -> 1478 px, easeIn [0.679, 0.283, 0.883, 1.105], rms 0.002)
r08 replica (artifacts/replicas/r08/build.mjs) builds the same beat with one circle per world

x.description: Start centre x (default comp centre): the element the iris grows out of.

toX.description: Optional end centre x (the disc rides there while it opens). Default: stays at x.

toY.description: Optional end centre y. Default: stays at y.

startSize.description: Start diameter px (default 5 % of the short side, about the size of the element it opens from).

delay.description: Frames at 30 fps before it starts opening.

open.description: Opening length, frames at 30 fps (r08: 8-9 f).

ease.description: Opening ease (measured r08 S3.E13 easeIn, accelerating into the cover).

rideEase.description: Ease of the centre ride (only when toX / toY are set).

name.description: Layer name (name it after the world it opens, e.g. 'S2 ground iris').

lets.X1: toX == null ? (x == null ? CX : x) : toX
lets.Y1: toY == null ? (y == null ? CY : y) : toY
